# McLaren Rentals Las Vegas

> McLaren supercar rental company in Las Vegas, NV. Rents the McLaren 570GT and 570S for $699.00/day, with no personal auto insurance required to rent.

McLaren Rentals Las Vegas rents the McLaren 570GT and McLaren 570S in Las Vegas, Nevada. Rentals are $699.00 per day, include a 100-mile daily allowance ($7.50/mile after that), and require a $500.00 refundable security deposit. Renters must be 25 or older with a valid driver's license; no personal auto insurance is required, and an optional McLaren protection package is available. Pickup, drop-off, and delivery are available at 5225 South Valley View Blvd, Suite 7, Las Vegas, NV 89118, open 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

## Fleet

- [McLaren 570GT](https://rentamclarenlasvegas.com/mclaren-570gt): Grand tourer McLaren, 562 hp, 3.3s 0-60, $699.00/day. Check live availability and book online.
- [McLaren 570S](https://rentamclarenlasvegas.com/mclaren-570s): Performance-focused McLaren, 562 hp, 3.2s 0-60, $699.00/day. Check live availability and book online.
